__InternalComment: Index of third-party legal notices for libraries Rinten uses. Only top-level dependencies are listed; their own dependencies are in their licence files.
Statement: Rinten is based on s&box by Facepunch Studios Ltd. The following libraries and components are included or used by Rinten. We appreciate the developers' contributions to open & shared software. Components licensed under the LGPL are dynamically linked and carry a SourceUrl pointing at the complete corresponding source; you may replace those libraries with your own build.

Components.Name: Yoga
Components.Comment: The interface's flexbox layout (engine/Rinten.Layout) is a C# port of Yoga's layout algorithm; no native Yoga library is linked.

Components.Name: SkiaSharp
Components.Comment: 2D graphics for text, UI and image work, with the HarfBuzzSharp text shaper.

Components.Name: HarfBuzz
Components.Comment: Text shaping, loaded through HarfBuzzSharp.

Components.Name: Topten.RichTextKit
Components.Comment: Rich text layout over SkiaSharp; vendored source in engine/ThirdParty.

Components.Name: Svg.Skia
Components.Comment: SVG rendering via SkiaSharp.

Components.Name: Material Design Icons
Components.Comment: Iconography font.

Components.Name: Inter
Components.Comment: UI font (game/addons/base/Assets/fonts, OFL.txt beside it).

Components.Name: Poppins
Components.Comment: Font (game/addons/base/Assets/fonts, OFL.txt beside it).

Components.Name: Roboto
Components.Comment: Roboto, Roboto Condensed and Roboto Mono fonts (game/addons/base/Assets/fonts, LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt beside them).

Components.Name: WebXR Input Profiles
Components.Comment: VR controller models, made from @webxr-input-profiles/assets (game/addons/base/Assets/models/vr/controllers). Some portray trademarks of their device makers.

Components.Name: MurmurHash
Components.Comment: Hash finaliser and word hash used for mesh and lightmap keys.

Components.Name: xxHash
Components.Comment: XXH3 ported to C# (Rinten.System, Rinten.Generator); the C xxhash ships with lz4.

Components.Name: lz4
Components.Comment: LZ4 compression, compiled into the native core.

Components.Name: meshoptimizer
Components.Comment: Cluster building, simplification, welding, bounds and the vertex codec are ported to C# from meshoptimizer.

Components.Name: recastnavigation
Components.Comment: Navigation mesh generation and pathfinding, ported to C# by way of recast4j and DotRecast (engine/Rinten.Engine/Game/Navigation).

Components.Name: Box2D
Components.Comment: 2D physics, compiled into the native core.

Components.Name: Box3D
Components.Comment: 3D physics, compiled into the native core.

Components.Name: miniaudio
Components.Comment: Audio device output, compiled into the native core.

Components.Name: ufbx
Components.Comment: FBX import, compiled into the native core.

Components.Name: stb
Components.Comment: stb_image and stb_vorbis, compiled into the native core.

Components.Name: Basis Universal
Components.Comment: KTX2/UASTC encoding for web builds, with its bundled zstd; see engine/Core/extern/basisu/NOTICE.

Components.Name: Slang
Components.Comment: Shading language compiler; compiles the engine's shaders to SPIR-V and WGSL.

Components.Name: SDL3
Components.Comment: Windowing, input and gamepads.

Components.Name: OpenXR
Components.Comment: Khronos OpenXR loader for VR headsets.

Components.Name: Silk.NET
Components.Comment: Vulkan, OpenXR and SPIRV-Cross bindings for .NET.

Components.Name: SPIRV-Cross
Components.Comment: SPIR-V reflection and cross-compilation, loaded through Silk.NET.SPIRV.Cross.Native.

Components.Name: FFmpeg
Components.Comment: Video decoding. BtbN's lgpl-shared build: configured without --enable-gpl and --enable-nonfree, loaded as shared libraries that can be replaced with any compatible build.

Components.Name: NVIDIA DLSS
Components.Comment: DLSS upscaling through NGX. Not in the repository: build-ngx.sh downloads the runtime at a pinned commit, and the SDK licence allows shipping that binary.

Components.Name: FidelityFX SDK
Components.Comment: FSR1 and FSR3 upscaling shaders (game/addons/base/Assets/shaders/engine/ffx).

Components.Name: Concentus
Components.Comment: A C# port of the Opus codec, used for voice chat; no native Opus library is loaded.
Copyright: Skype Limited, Xiph.Org Foundation, CSIRO, Microsoft Corporation, Jean-Marc Valin, Gregory Maxwell, Mark Borgerding, Timothy B. Terriberry, Logan Stromberg

Components.Name: LiteDB
Components.Comment: Embedded database used by the editor's cloud asset directory.

Components.Name: dotnet
Components.Comment: .NET runtime and base class libraries, Roslyn, Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory, System.Numerics.Tensors, System.Speech, System.CodeDom, System.CommandLine, ClrMD (Microsoft.Diagnostics.Runtime) and the NativeAOT-LLVM compiler for web builds.

Components.Name: MonoMod
Components.Comment: Runtime detouring for code hotload.

Components.Name: Mono.Cecil
Components.Comment: Assembly reading and writing for hotload.

Components.Name: NLog
Components.Comment: Logging.

Components.Name: Humanizer
Components.Comment: Human-readable strings for numbers, dates and names.

Components.Name: Vestris.ResourceLib
Components.Comment: Reads and writes Windows executable resources.

Components.Name: protobuf-net
Components.Comment: Protocol Buffers serialisation for services.

Components.Name: Refit
Components.Comment: Typed REST clients for services.

Components.Name: Zio
Components.Comment: Virtual filesystem abstraction.

Components.Name: Html Agility Pack
Components.Comment: HTML parser, vendored and trimmed in engine/Rinten.System/Html.

Components.Name: FastNoise
Components.Comment: Noise generation, vendored in engine/Rinten.System/ThirdParty/FastNoise.cs.

Components.Name: Facepunch.ActionGraphs
Components.Comment: Node graph runtime behind ActionGraph. To be replaced by our own implementation before the source is opened: it carries no licence that allows redistribution.

Components.Name: AWSSDK.S3
Components.Comment: Build artifact uploads; build tool only, not shipped.

Components.Name: JetBrains.Refasmer
Components.Comment: Reference assembly generation; build tool only, not shipped.

Components.Name: nvpatch
Components.Comment: Marks Windows executables to prefer the discrete GPU; build tool only, downloaded, not shipped.
